slides.headline: Search “[your brand] reddit”. That's what your customers are doing.
People add “reddit” to find opinions they trust.
slides.body: Not ads, not your site — strangers.

slides.headline: A thread titled “Is [brand] a scam?” can rank for years.
Old threads don't fade.
slides.body: They stay indexed long after the conversation is over.

slides.headline: And you can't edit the title.
slides.body: Whatever it says, it keeps saying.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
